Like the ancient Greek goddess, Isleana symbolizes a sacred refuge, encouraging us to lean on our faith for guidance and strength even in the midst of adversity. Just as sailors were drawn to the protective embrace of the goddess's islands, so too are we called by God to find solace and respite in His divine presence. Thus, the name Isleana evokes a sense of faith, hope, and trust in God's providence, offering comfort and guidance on our spiritual journeys.
